title: Photosynthesis

entries.notes: The process by which plants, algae, and some bacteria convert light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose.
Carbon dioxide (from air), water (from soil), and light energy (from the sun).
Glucose (stored chemical energy) and oxygen (released as a byproduct).

summary: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose, using CO2 and water as inputs and releasing oxygen as a byproduct.
